meta.title: Git 栏（轻量）
meta.description: GitHub Desktop 风格的 Git 面板：变更文件、勾选提交、舍弃进回收站、Commit and Push、diff 预览。

bundle.text:
# dsh-lite-git — loader rows.
#
# One dual-face plugin row: the node half (exports ".") runs in the Host process
# and serves this plugin's `/api/dsh-lite-git/rpc` route; the `dsh.client`
# declaration in package.json makes the browser half (exports "./client") load
# in the Web GUI as a right-sidebar tab type.
#
# `name` must be this package's manifest name verbatim — dsh-client-modules keys
# every browser row by it, and lib/client.js registers its factory under the
# same id. `id` is the profile entry id, and it must stay equal to the package
# name because the settings service keys its descriptors by it and the client
# half repeats both as literals.
#
# `config` is deliberately empty. Every field of `Config` is volatile, so values
# the user changes live in this profile's own patch layer and survive an upgrade
# of this package; restating them here would shadow those edits.
- insert:
    - id: dsh-lite-git
      name: dsh-lite-git

readme.text:
**给 DSH 用的 GitHub Desktop 风格 Git 面板**——装在 DSH **自带的右侧栏**里，和「文件 / 文档 / 聊天」并排。

变更文件列表、勾选提交、Summary + Description、Commit / Commit and Push、一个会随分支状态变化的 Push/Fetch 按钮、舍弃更改进插件自己的回收站、双击看 diff——都在这一栏里。

> English: [README.en.md](./README.en.md)

> **0.7.0 起改名为 `dsh-lite-git`**（原 `dsh-gitbar-lite`）。包的 id、RPC 路由、状态目录都跟着换了，所以升级时要把旧的卸掉：
> `dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-gitbar-lite`，再按下面的「安装」装新的；
> 旧的 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite/`（仓库绑定、脚本、回收站）可以整个搬到 `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/` 继续用。

readme.section: 为什么是「右侧栏的一个 tab」
readme.text:
DSH 的右栏本来就是一个常驻的标签区。Git 面板放这里，意味着它和会话是同一份上下文：**当前会话的工作区就是它看的仓库**，切换会话就跟着切，不用再挑一次目录。

面板很窄（右栏最小 300px，窄视口下会自动全屏），所以它是按窄栏设计的：文件列表单列、路径按「文件名 + 目录」两级显示、提交框只留一个 Summary 输入框加一个可展开的小三角。

| 功能 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| 变更文件列表 | 修改 / 新增 / 删除 / 重命名 / 未跟踪都能识别，每行带 `+n −n` 行数统计 |
| 勾选 | **勾选就是真的 `git add`**，取消就是 `git restore --staged`。终端里 `git status` 看到的就是同一件事 |
| 半暂存 | 一个文件索引和工作区都有改动时，勾选框显示成「半选」，点一下把它整体重述为勾上或没勾 |
| 全选 | 列表标题左边一个三态框：全选 / 取消全选，部分勾选时显示半选。**冲突文件不参与**，和自动勾选同一条规则 |
| 自动勾选 | **刷新时不看上一次，只看这一次新出现的**：列表重读之后，屏幕上新冒出来的改动自动勾上，已经在列表里的文件保持你留下的样子——所以刷新**不会**把你刚取消勾的文件勾回来。冲突文件、半暂存的文件不参与。**第一次打开**（或提交完）沿用老规则：索引里一个文件都没有才全部勾上；索引非空说明别处已经做过选择，不动 |
| Summary / Description | Summary 常驻一行；最右边一个小三角展开 Description |
| Commit | 只提交勾上的（因为勾选写进了索引） |
| Commit and Push | 提交后立刻推送；**推送失败不会说「提交失败」**——提交已经发生了，面板会明说「已提交 xxx，但推送失败」 |
| 上下文按钮 | 有本地未推送提交时是 **Push**，没有上游时是 **Publish**，否则是 **Fetch** |
| Push 前先 Fetch | 推送前会先 `git fetch --prune`，然后才推。**已经落后就拒绝推**并说明落后几个——git 的 push 从不合并，早晚都是被拒，先知道比推完再被拒有用。fetch 本身失败不阻断推送 |
| 自动 Fetch | 面板可见且仓库有远端时按 GitHub Desktop 的口径自己抓：默认 1 小时，每次到点重新判断，下一次从**上一次完成后**开始排，并加随机抖动防止多个面板同步。节奏是 `autoFetchMs`（`0` 关掉），并且用 `FETCH_HEAD` 的 mtime 判断"是不是刚抓过"——你在终端里抓也算 |
| 面板获得焦点 | **每次重新看向面板**都刷新一遍列表，并跑一遍脚本填 Summary：**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口、浏览器标签回来，都算。手写的 Summary 不会被覆盖——只有空着的、或者还留着上次脚本填的那句话时才自动填 |
| 舍弃更改 | 单个文件或「全部舍弃」；动手前先把这次改动的 diff 归档，确认框里可以勾「彻底删除」 |
| 回收站 | 独立 tab。每次舍弃存一

| 需要什么 | 说明 |
|---|---|
| DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | 右侧栏 tab API 是这一版的行为 |
| Node `>= 22` | 宿主半边用到 `AbortSignal.any` 与 `node:test` |
| **本机有一个 `git`** | 默认从 `PATH` 找；找不到时面板会明确说「本机找不到 git」，不会静默失败。装在别处可以用 `gitPath` 指定 |
| 凭据 | Push 用的是**系统 git 的凭据**（credential helper）。先在终端里成功 push 过一次，插件就跟着能推 |

插件不会自己存任何凭据。宿主半边不读 `$DSH_HOME` 里的密钥，也不写。

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> add dsh-lite-git
```

装完**重启 DSH**。然后在一个会话里打开右侧栏，引导页上会多一张 **「Git 更改」** 卡片，点它就进面板。

<details>
<summary>从本地克隆安装 / 卸载 / 装完打不开怎么办</summary>

**本地目录安装**（改代码时用这个）：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/绝对路径/dsh-lite-git
```

**卸载**：

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <你的 profile> remove dsh-lite-git
```

**装完 DSH 起不来**：先跑 `node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs .`。DSH 把
`exports["./client"]` 当**精确文件路径**读，没有扩展名补全也没有目录回退；指向一个不存在的文件会直接
`MissingClientBundleError` **中止整个 Host 启动**，而不是「这个插件不显示」。这个脚本就是复刻那条判定，让你不必靠重启去试。

</details>

```
右栏引导页
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▸ Git 更改                      │  ← 引导卡片，点开面板
│    查看改动、勾选要提交的文件…    │

- **勾选**：点一下写进索引，再点一下撤出。半选状态点一下会整体勾上，再点整体撤出。
- **双击文件行** → 右栏开 diff 标签页；再双击别的文件，**复用同一个标签页**。
- **舍弃**（行尾 ↩ 或「全部舍弃」）→ 弹确认框：

```
  舍弃「a.txt」的更改？
   · a.txt
   ☐ 彻底删除（不存入回收站）
     这次的 diff 会存进插件的回收站，之后还能回看是改了什么。

**默认不勾「彻底删除」**：这次改动的 diff 会存进回收站。勾上就什么都不留。这个勾选框会记住你上一次的选择。
- **回收站**（🗄）：按时间列出记录，每条显示「多久之前 · 单个文件/全部更改 · 文件数 · +n −n · 基于 `abc1234 初始提交`」。
  点一条看 diff，点 ↺ 把它恢复回工作区（**恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的**），行尾的 🗑 删掉它，
  右上「清空回收站」一次清掉（只清当前仓库，勾上「显示全部仓库」就清全部）。
- **解绑**（🔗）：解除当前绑定。**当前工作区本身就是仓库根目录时这个按钮是灰的**——那种情况下清掉绑定，
  下一次读又会把同一个目录自动绑定回来，点了等于什么都没发生；按钮的 tooltip 会说明原因。
  工作区不是仓库根目录时（比如工作区是某个仓库的子目录，或是一个普通目录手动绑到了某个仓库），按钮可用。

readme.section: 正在 Push / Fetch 的时候
readme.text:
Push、Fetch、Commit 这类动作是网络往返，可能持续几十秒。进行中时，右上角那个上下文按钮会**原地变成一个
转圈的动画**，旁边写着「正在Push…」之类；同时「上次 Fetch」那行让位给它，刷新和回收站按钮禁用。
动作结束（无论成功还是失败）就恢复原状。勾选文件的暂存/取消暂存不触发转圈：那是本地 `git add`，
几十毫秒的事，为它把整个面板变忙反而会让人以为卡了。

顺序是固定的，不能换：

1. 按当前改动生成 diff（已跟踪的文件走 `git diff HEAD`；**未跟踪的新文件由插件自己合成一份 new-file diff**，
   因为 `git diff HEAD` 看不见它们，而舍弃未跟踪文件就是删掉它——不先合成，回收站里就只剩一条「删了一个文件」的空记录）。
2. 存进回收站（除非勾了「彻底删除」）。
3. 已跟踪的 `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`；未跟踪的直接删文件，并把因此变空的目录一起清掉。

> **冲突中的文件会被拒绝舍弃**，只给一句提示。在合并中途 `git restore` 到 HEAD 有扰动合并状态的风险，不值得为省一句话去冒。

**脚本就在面板里写**：展开 Description 的小三角，下面有一个「填 Summary 的脚本」按钮，点开是一个编辑框——写进去、保存、运行并填入，全在这里，不用去翻配置文件。**编辑框一开始是空的**，什么都不会预先填进去（占位提示里给了一个例子）；保存、运行、刷新都会给一条短暂提示，不用猜刚才那一下到底按到没有。**每次重新看向面板都会自动跑一次**（**打开面板**、切回这个标签、从对话点回面板、切回 DSH 窗口都算）——把侧边栏开着，去对话里让 agent 干活，回来，Summary 已经填好了；不过**你自己手写过的 Summary 不会被冲掉**，那时想更新就点星星按钮。配了脚本之后，Summary 框旁边还会多一个星星按钮，一点就填。

脚本以**仓库根目录为工作目录**运行，不喂任何 stdin。所以「取 CHANGELOG 最顶上的版本号」就是：

```sh
grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | sed 's/^## //'
```

输出即 Summary。要同时填 Description，就在输出里单独放一行 `---`，**该行之后**的全部内容是 Description：

```sh
echo "1.4.2"
echo "---"
echo "Bumped the patch version."
```

关于 shell：Windows 上优先用 Git 自带的 `sh`（`grep`/`sed`/`awk` 都可用），并把它的 `usr/bin` 补回 `PATH`——否则那些工具会「command not found」。机器上没有 `sh` 才退回 `cmd.exe`，那时脚本要按 cmd 语法写。非 Windows 就是 `sh`。

脚本失败不弹错误横幅，退出码会以一条短暂提示显示；它的 stderr 原样保留，方便你自己判断。
> 脚本是**按仓库**存的（键是仓库路径，文件在 <DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/scripts.json）：A 项目配的脚本不会跑到 B 项目里。一个从没配过脚本的仓库，编辑框是**空的**——不预先填任何脚本，占位提示只给个例子；清空保存之后它也真的空着。

| 字段 | 默认 | 说明 |
|---|---|---|
| `gitPath` | `""` | 指定 git 可执行文件；空 = 从 `PATH` 找 |
| `stateDir` | `""` | 插件状态目录；空 = `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | 单条 git 命令超时。推到慢远端可以调大 |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `524288` | 一份归档 diff 的上限；超出按**行**截断并记下丢了多少行 |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | 比这大的未跟踪文件只列出来，不读内容、不归档、不出 diff |
| `trashLimit` | `200` | 回收站保留多少条；超出丢弃最旧的连同它的 diff 文件 |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | 「不是仓库时」扫描工作区找仓库的目录深度 |
| `autoFetchMs` | `300000` | 面板自己多久 fetch 一次；`0` = 关掉，只用手动按钮 |
| `summaryScript` | `""` | 填 Summary 的脚本。以仓库根为工作目录运行，输出即 Summary；单独一行 `---` 之后算 Description |
| `openWith` | `[]` | diff 页右上角「用…打开」的下拉里，**额外**多出来的程序。每项 `{ label, command, args }`，`args` 里 `{path}` 换成文件、`{dir}` 换成所在目录，都不写就把路径接在最后（例：`- label: VS Code` / `command: code` / `args: ['{path}']`）。每项已经是**一个参数**，不是 shell 命令行，所以带空格的路径不会被拆开。系统自带的那三个（系统默认程序 / 记事本 / 在文件夹中显示）不用写，一直都在 |

每个字段都是 volatile 的，所以在设置页改了立刻生效、不用重启。

**状态存在哪**：`<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/`（没有 `DSH_HOME` 就回落 `~/.dsh`）——
`bindings.json`（工作区 → 仓库）、`prefs.json`（那两个勾选偏好）、`trash/index.json` + `trash/<id>.diff`。
**回收站只存那一个 diff，不额外留一份文件副本**：恢复时用 `git apply` 把它重放回去，
那既是面板显示的记录，也是回放所需的全部内容；重放完再把这些路径 `git add` 进索引，
所以恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的。都是先写临时文件再 rename，所以写到一半崩了也不会把文件截断。

```
lib/shared.js          线协议字面量（浏览器半边手抄一份，自检脚本负责比对）
lib/index.js           插件入口：Config、apply、把路由挂到 connection.fetch
lib/host/git.js        git 执行层：走 ctx.subprocess，解析可执行文件、限流输出、清洗环境
lib/host/parse.js      porcelain v2 / numstat 解析（纯函数）

几个值得写下来的决定：

- **一条 `/api` 路由 + `action` 字段**，不是一条路由一个操作。`connection.fetch` 按精确 pathname 匹配，
  而每次调用本来就要带 `sessionId`；分开写只会把十五个路径字面量摊到两种语言里。
- **必须挂在 `connection.fetch` 上，绝不挂 `webServer` 的 exact 路由**：web server 会先匹配 exact 路由，
  而同路径的 exact 路由会遮蔽 `/api` 前缀路由——Host/Origin fence、浏览器 cookie 校验、operator 身份**全在那条前缀路由上**。
  用 exact 就等于开了一个不需要鉴权的 git 接口。测试与自检脚本都专门盯这一条，并且**反过来验证这条断言是有牙齿的**。
- **diff tab 用 `dsh-resource://` 固定地址**，不是 page kind。重新打开同一个资源地址会让宿主**聚焦已开的那个 tab**，
  并把新的 `params` 导航进去；page kind 只在当前 dock pane 内复用，被浮动出去就会多开一个。固定地址本身就是「永远只占一个」。
- **不发 `-m`，用 `-F -` 把提交信息从 stdin 送进去**：Summary 里有引号、有换行、以 `-` 开头，都只是文本，不是参数。
- **`:(literal)` pathspec**：否则舍弃一个叫 `docs` 的文件会顺带动 `docs/` 里的所有东西，`a[1].txt` 会被当成通配。
- **不 import `@deepseek-ai/dsh-client-ui-primitives`**：浏览器半边只 `require('react')`。
  一个会抛错的 import 会把整个 slot entry 变成空白，而官方插件开发清单也要求客户端半边不导入 Harness Client 包。
  需要的那几个控件手写，颜色全部走 `--dsw-alias-*` token；图标是**逐 path 抄宿主 `IconBranchOutlineRegular`
  等 artwork**，所以它和旁边的宿主图标是一套东西。
更多细节（线协议全表、状态文件格式、为什么这么排序、哪些没验证）在 [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](./docs/CONTRACT.md)。

```sh
npm test          # 单测 + 真 git 的 e2e + 产物自检
npm run test:e2e  # 只跑真 git 的 e2e（23 个小节，各自造自己的夹具，294 项断言）
npm run check     # 只用产物自检（不启 DSH 也能发现会让 DSH 起不来的问题）
npm run test:live # 探测一个正在运行的 DSH（不在 npm test 里，需要跑着应用）

| 套件 | 覆盖什么 |
|---|---|
| `test/parse.test.mjs` | porcelain v2 与 numstat 解析，含重命名、暂存删除、冲突、非 ASCII 路径、带空格的路径 |
| `test/diff.test.mjs` | diff 合成（含无尾换行、二进制、CRLF）、按行截断不切断多字节字符、按文件切分 |
| `test/store.test.mjs` | 绑定键归一、绑定/偏好/回收站往返、坏文件容错、并发写不丢更新 |
| `test/index.test.mjs` | Config 字段与默认值、**路由载体与「只注册一次」**、错误码映射 |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | 按 manifest 的确切路径加载真实 bundle；三个 tab 类型的 id/kind/guide/keepMounted；每个 slot key 都是注册过的 id；字典与错误码齐全；无 hook 的三个组件按渲染树断言 |
| `test/seats.test.mjs` | **把每个注册进来的 seat 都渲染一遍**，含隐藏态和无 session 态。这是补盲区的：`client.test.mjs` 从不渲染三个 body，而 body 渲染期抛错就是整个面板变白（真实发生过——一个 `const` 被依赖数组提前引用，ReferenceError 打白了面板，而其余测试全绿） |
| `test/focus.test.mjs` | **唯一会跑 effect 的套件**：拿真实 bundle 跑在一个小号 React 上（state / effect / 依赖比较 / ref），断言「重新看向面板」真的发生了——打开读一次、回来再读一次、冷却期内的连发只读一次、切走再切回也算——以及重读之后**勾的是哪几个文件**：新出现的才勾，取消过的保持没勾，索引非空时不覆盖别人的选择。别的套件都不跑 effect，所以这类 bug 它们看不见 |
| `test/e2e.mjs` | 真实 git、真实 handler、真实路由层：勾选真的写索引（之后读 `git status` 回来比对）、提交、push 到本地裸远端、推送被拒、舍弃单文件/全部/重命名/暂存删除、冲突拒绝、回收站增删清空、按仓库过滤、扫描深度 |
| `test/check.mjs` | manifest 指向的文件都存在且进得了 tarball、patch 层只有一行且没有密钥、两份线协议字面量一致、字典与 `locale/*.json` 一致、每个 `t('字面量')` 都能查到、README/workflow 的存在性与内容 |
| `scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs` | 复刻 client-m

**没有真浏览器 harness**，这是有意的：本插件不做任何 DOM 量测、不增强宿主 DOM、没有 portal 到 `document.body` 的东西，
而那套夹具的忠实性本身就是负担（同家族的插件曾因为夹具抄错一条 CSS 规则，把 bug 固化成绿色）。
`test/client.test.mjs` 里无 hook 的三个组件是按**渲染树**断言的，覆盖了勾选状态、确认框默认值、候选人列表这些真正的 UI 规则。
如果以后 UI 长出依赖 `:hover` 或需要量测的东西，这里就该重新考虑——那条判断写进了 `docs/CONTRACT.md`。

- 一个工作区绑一个仓库，一个仓库一次推一个远端（有 `origin` 就优先它）。不做子模块、worktree、分支切换、历史列表、stash。
- Fetch 用的是 `git fetch --prune`，会删掉远端已经删除的分支对应的 remote-tracking ref（和 GitHub Desktop 一致）。
- 提交会跑你自己的 commit hook。卡住的 hook 是你自己的 hook；`timeoutMs` 是唯一的兜底。
- 回收站只存那一个 **diff**。恢复是把它 `git apply` 回去，所以能恢复出一模一样的字节（CRLF、无尾换行、
  unicode、行尾空格都验过）。但它只能在「工作区还是舍弃后的样子」时重放：HEAD 变了，或那些文件又被改过，
  按钮就变灰并说明原因——否则就是拿旧改动盖掉新改动。
  **恢复出来的文件回到列表时是勾上的**：重放之后宿主会把这些路径 `git add` 进索引，
  和「任何改动都默认勾选」是同一条规则，也和本插件「勾选就是真的索引」一致——终端里 `git status` 看到的就是这样。
  **恢复成功后这条记录会被移除**：它是舍弃的逆操作，放回去之后档案就没有用处了，
  而且再重放一次会把同一个改动应用两遍。
- 二进制文件不归档内容，只记一句 `Binary files … differ`。这很诚实，但那不是备份。
- 超过 `maxFileBytes` 的未跟踪文件被舍弃时，归档里只有一段说明。确认框目前不会特别提示这一点。
- 「舍弃未跟踪文件」是直接删除（不进系统回收站）——这是说好的设计：插件自己的回收站承接它，不勾「彻底删除」时能看到内容。
- 「用…打开」是在**宿主那台机器**上启动程序的：手机 / 另一台电脑远程看的时候，窗口开在持有仓库的那台机器上，不是开在你面前这块屏幕上。它也只作用于**仓库里的文件**：回收站记录的 diff、已经被删掉的文件都没有磁盘上的东西可以递过去。

版本号就是发布按钮：

1. 改 `package.json` 的 `version`。
2. 推到 `main`。

`.github/workflows/publish.yml` 会跑 `npm test`，然后 `npm view <name>@<version>`——**该版本已经在线就静默跳过**（绿色的 no-op，并提示你 bump）。所以漏改版本号不会静默重发，也不会变成一次红色失败。

认证是 npm 的 **Trusted Publishing（OIDC）**：没有任何 token secret，`id-token: write` 就是全部凭据。

<details>
<summary>一次性配置：在 npmjs.com 上绑定 Trusted Publisher</summary>

包的页面 → Settings → Trusted Publisher，填：

| 字段 | 值 |
|---|---|
| Publisher | GitHub Actions |
| Repository | `Ckarefulon/dsh-lite-git` |
| Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |
| Environment | （留空） |

**首次发布必须手工 `npm publish`**——Trusted Publisher 只能绑到一个已经存在于 registry 上的包名。

工作流刻意**不用** `actions/setup-node` 的 `registry-url`：它会往 `~/.npmrc` 写
`_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}`，而这个字面占位符会被当成凭据发出去。registry 由 `publishConfig` 提供。

另外它会先把 npm 升到 `^11.5.1`：Trusted Publishing 是 npm CLI 的能力，Node 22 自带的 npm 10 不支持 OIDC 交换，
在 npm 10 上会以 `ENEEDAUTH` 失败——那看起来像缺 token，其实是 npm 太旧。

</details>

「GitHub Desktop」是 GitHub, Inc. 的产品名称；本插件不是 GitHub 的产品，也与 GitHub 无关，只是借用了那种布局。

**A GitHub Desktop-style Git panel for DSH**, living in DSH's **built-in right sidebar** — beside Files, Document and Chat.

Changed files, tick-to-stage, a Summary plus a collapsible Description, Commit and Commit and Push, one context button that is Push or Fetch depending on the branch, a discard that archives into the plugin's own trash, and a diff preview — all in that column.

> 中文：[README.md](./README.md)

> **Renamed to `dsh-lite-git` in 0.7.0** (it used to be `dsh-gitbar-lite`). The package id, the RPC route and the
> state directory all moved with it, so remove the old one first: `dsh plugin --profile <your profile> remove dsh-gitbar-lite`,
> then install as below. The old `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-gitbar-lite/` (repository bindings, scripts, trash) can be moved to
> `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/` and keeps working.

The right column is already a permanent tab strip. Putting the panel there means it shares the session's context: **the repository it shows is the one the active session works in**, so switching sessions switches repositories without picking a directory again.

The column is narrow (300px minimum, and a narrow viewport makes it full-screen), so the panel is built for that width: a single-column file list, paths split into name and directory, and a commit box that is one Summary field plus a small triangle that reveals the Description.

| | |
|---|---|
| Change list | Modified, added, deleted, renamed and untracked, each with its `+n −n` line counts |
| Ticking | **A tick is a real `git add`**; unticking is `git restore --staged`. What a terminal's `git status` shows is the same thing |
| Half-staged files | When the index and the worktree are both dirty the tick renders indeterminate; either click restates the file as a whole |
| Select all | A tri-state box left of the list heading: tick everything, untick everything, and it reads as mixed when the selection is partial. **Conflicted files are excluded**, the same rule the automatic selection follows |
| Automatic selection | **A refresh looks at what is new, not at what was chosen last time.** After the list is re-read, changes that have just appeared are ticked, and files that were already in the list are left exactly as you left them — so a refresh **never** re-takes a file you just unticked. Conflicted files and half-staged files are never ticked automatically. **The first look** (and the one right after a commit) keeps the original opening rule: tick everything while the index is empty; a non-empty index means someone already chose, so it is left alone |
| S

| | |
|---|---|
| DSH `>= 0.2.0-rc.2` | The right-sidebar tab API is this version's behaviour |
| Node `>= 22` | The host half uses `AbortSignal.any` and `node:test` |
| **A local `git`** | Found on `PATH` by default. When it cannot be found the panel says so plainly instead of failing silently; point `gitPath` at it if it lives somewhere unusual |
| A credential | Push uses **the system git's credential helper**. Push once successfully from a terminal and the plugin can push too |
The plugin stores no credential of its own, and the host half reads no secret out of `$DSH_HOME`.

```sh
dsh plugin --profile <your profile> add dsh-lite-git
```

Restart DSH. Open the right column in a session; its guide page gains a **"Git changes"** card, and that opens the panel.

<details>
<summary>Installing from a local clone / uninstalling / what to do when DSH will not start</summary>

**From a local directory** (use this while changing the code):

```sh
dsh plugin --profile desktop add link:/absolute/path/dsh-lite-git
```

**Uninstall**:

**DSH will not start after installing**: run `node scripts/check-client-bundle.mjs .` first. DSH reads
`exports["./client"]` as an **exact file path** — no extension completion, no directory fallback — and a manifest
pointing at a file that does not exist raises `MissingClientBundleError` and **aborts the whole Host boot** rather
than merely hiding the plugin. That script reproduces the same resolution so you do not have to find out by restarting.

</details>

```
right column, guide page
┌──────────────────────────────────┐
│  ▸ Git changes                   │  ← the guide card
│    Review changes, tick what…     │

- **Ticking** writes the index; unticking takes it back out. An indeterminate file ticks as a whole, and a second click unticks it as a whole.
- **Double-click a row** opens the diff tab; double-clicking another file **reuses that same tab**.
- **Discard** (the ↩ at the end of a row, or "Discard all") opens a confirmation:

```
  Discard the changes to "a.txt"?
   · a.txt
   ☐ Delete for good (keep no copy)
     This diff is stored in the plugin's trash, so you can still see what was discarded.

**"Delete for good" is unticked by default**, so the diff is archived; tick it and nothing is kept. The box
  remembers your last answer.
- **The trash** (🗄) lists entries by time: how long ago, one file or all changes, the file count, `+n −n`, and
  `against abc1234 initial commit`. Click one for its diff, 🗑 at the end of a row deletes it, and "Empty the trash"
  clears them (only the bound repository, or everything with "Show every repository" ticked).
- **Unbind** (🔗) clears the current binding. **The button is greyed out when the workspace *is* the
  repository root**: clearing the binding there would only re-detect the same directory on the next read,
  so the press would report success and change nothing. The tooltip says as much. It stays live when the
  workspace is somewhere else — a subdirectory of a repository, or a plain folder bound to one by hand.

readme.section: While a push or a fetch is running
readme.text:
Push, fetch and commit are network round trips that can take tens of seconds. While one is in flight the
context button in the header **turns into a spinner in place**, with a sentence beside it ("Pushing…"),
the last-fetch line yields its room, and refresh and trash are disabled. Whatever happens — success or
failure — the header goes back to normal afterwards. Ticking a file does *not* do this: that is a local
`git add` of a few tens of milliseconds, and treating it as a long job would make every click feel stuck.

1. Build a diff of the current changes. Tracked files come from `git diff HEAD`; **untracked new files are turned
   into a synthesized new-file diff by the plugin**, because `git diff HEAD` cannot see them and discarding an
   untracked file deletes it — without synthesizing, the archive would be a bare "one file was deleted".
2. Store it in the trash, unless "delete for good" was ticked.
3. Tracked paths: `git restore --source=HEAD --staged --worktree`. Untracked paths: delete the file, then prune the
   directories that the discard emptied.

> **A conflicted file is refused**, with one sentence. Running `git restore` to HEAD in the middle of a merge can
> disturb the merge state, and that risk is not worth saving a sentence.

readme.section: Filling the Summary from a script
readme.text:
**The script is written in the panel.** Below the Description field there is a "script that fills the Summary" toggle;
open it and you get an editor — write it, save it, run it, all without leaving the sidebar. **The editor starts empty**
and nothing is ever seeded into it (the placeholder shows an example); saving, running and refreshing all say so in a
brief notice, so there is no guessing whether the press landed. It also runs by itself **when the panel is opened, and
every time it is looked at again** (switching back to this tab, clicking into the panel from the conversation, or
returning to the DSH window): leave the sidebar open, go and let the agent work in the conversation, come back, and the
Summary is already there. A Summary **you** typed is not overwritten — use the sparkle button when you want it refreshed
anyway. Once a script exists, a sparkle button appears next to the Summary field as a one-click path.

readme.section: Filling the Summary from a script
readme.text:
It runs with the **repository root as its working directory** and is fed nothing on stdin, so "read the top version out
of the CHANGELOG" is:

```sh
grep -m1 '^## ' CHANGELOG.md | sed 's/^## //'
```

Whatever it prints becomes the Summary. To fill the Description as well, put a line reading `---` in the output:
everything after it is the Description.

```sh
echo "1.4.2"
echo "---"
echo "Bumped the patch version."
```

readme.section: Filling the Summary from a script
readme.text:
About the shell: on Windows the script prefers Git's own `sh` (so `grep`/`sed`/`awk` work) and puts its `usr/bin` back on
`PATH` — without that those tools report "command not found". Only a machine with no `sh` at all falls back to
`cmd.exe`, where the script must be written in cmd syntax. Elsewhere it is plain `sh`.

A failing script does not raise an error banner; its exit code shows as a brief notice, and its stderr is kept verbatim so
you can judge for yourself.

readme.section: Filling the Summary from a script
readme.text:
> The script is stored **per repository** (keyed by its path, in `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/scripts.json`), so one
> project never runs another one's script. A repository that has never had one opens an **empty** editor — no built-in
> script is filled in, the placeholder is only an example — and an emptied script stays empty.

| field | default | |
|---|---|---|
| `gitPath` | `""` | Explicit git executable; empty means "look on `PATH`" |
| `stateDir` | `""` | Plugin state directory; empty means `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git` |
| `timeoutMs` | `30000` | Per-command timeout. Raise it for a slow remote |
| `maxDiffBytes` | `524288` | Ceiling on one archived diff; it is cut on a **line** boundary and the dropped lines are recorded |
| `maxFileBytes` | `2097152` | Larger untracked files are listed but not read, archived, or diffed |
| `trashLimit` | `200` | Trash entries kept; the oldest are dropped along with their diff files |
| `scanDepth` | `3` | Directory depth the picker scans below the workspace root |
| `autoFetchMs` | `300000` | How often the panel fetches on its own; `0` disables it, leaving the manual button |
| `summaryScript` | `""` | A script that fills the Summary. It runs with the repository root as its working directory and whatever it prints becomes the Summary; a line reading `---` starts the Description |
| `openWith` | `[]` | Extra programs for the diff tab's "open with" menu, on top of the platform's own three. Each row is `{ label, command, args }`; in `args`, `{path}` becomes the file and `
Every field is volatile, so a change on the settings page takes effect without a restart.

**Where state lives**: `<DSH_HOME>/dsh-lite-git/` (falling back to `~/.dsh`) — `bindings.json` (workspace →
repository), `prefs.json` (the two remembered choices), and `trash/index.json` plus `trash/<id>.diff`. The trash keeps
**that one diff and nothing else** — no second copy of the file: restoring replays it with `git apply`, so the record the
panel shows and the thing a restore needs are the same bytes. Every write goes through a temp file and a rename, so a
crash mid-write cannot truncate a file.

```
lib/shared.js          wire contract literals (the browser half repeats them; the self-check compares)
lib/index.js           entry: Config, apply, one route on connection.fetch
lib/host/git.js        git execution via ctx.subprocess; resolves the executable, bounds output, scrubs env
lib/host/parse.js      porcelain v2 / numstat parsing (pure)

The decisions worth writing down:

- **One `/api` route with an `action` field**, not one route per operation. `connection.fetch` matches on the exact
  pathname and every call already carries a `sessionId`; separate routes would spread fifteen path literals across
  two languages.
- **It must register on `connection.fetch`, never as a `webServer` exact route.** The web server resolves exact
  routes *before* its `/api` prefix route, and the Host/Origin fence, the browser-cookie check and the operator peer
  all hang off that prefix route — so an exact route on the same path is an unauthenticated git surface. Both the
  tests and the self-check assert the carrier, and the self-check **proves its own assertion is sensitive** by running
  the predicate against a deliberately broken copy of the source.
- **The diff tab is a `dsh-resource://` address, not a page kind.** Re-opening a resource address makes the host
  reveal the tab that is already open and re-navigate it with the new `params`; a page kind reuses only within the
  active dock pane, so a floated tab would get a second copy. The fixed address *is* "one diff tab, ever".
- **Commit messages go in over stdin (`-F -`), not `-m`**: a Summary containing a quote,

The full wire contract, the state-file formats, why the discard order is what it is, and what has *not* been verified
are in [`docs/CONTRACT.md`](./docs/CONTRACT.md).

```sh
npm test          # unit + real-git e2e + artifact self-check
npm run test:e2e  # the real-git suite alone (23 sections building their own fixtures, 294 assertions)
npm run check     # artifact self-check alone (catches boot-breaking mistakes without restarting DSH)
npm run test:live # probe a running DSH (not part of npm test; needs the app running)

| suite | covers |
|---|---|
| `test/parse.test.mjs` | porcelain v2 and numstat parsing, including a rename, a staged delete, a conflict, a non-ASCII path and a path with a space |
| `test/diff.test.mjs` | diff synthesis (missing trailing newline, binary, CRLF), truncation that never splits a character, per-file splitting |
| `test/store.test.mjs` | binding-key normalization, bindings/preferences/trash round-trips, corruption tolerance, no lost update under concurrent writers |
| `test/index.test.mjs` | Config fields and defaults, **the route carrier and single registration**, error-code mapping |
| `test/client.test.mjs` | the real bundle loaded from the manifest's exact path; the three tab types' ids/kinds/guide/keepMounted; every slot key being a registered id; both dictionaries and every failure code; the three hook-free components asserted on their element trees |
| `test/seats.test.mjs` | **every registered seat rendered**, including hidden and no-session states. This one closes a blind spot: `client.test.mjs` never renders the three bodies, and a render-time error in a body blanks the whole panel — which really happened (a `const` named by a dependency array before it was de

**There is no real-browser harness**, deliberately: this plugin measures no DOM, augments no host DOM, and portals
nothing to `document.body`, and the fixture's fidelity is itself a cost — plugins in this family have had a bug
frozen green because the fixture copied a CSS rule wrong. The three components with no hooks in them *are* asserted
on their rendered trees, which covers the rules that matter (a tick reflects the index, the confirmation defaults to
keeping a copy, the picker lists its candidates). If the UI ever grows something hover-dependent or measured, that
judgement should be revisited; it is recorded in `docs/CONTRACT.md`.

- One repository per workspace, one remote per push (`origin` when present). No submodules, worktrees, branch
  switching, history list, or stash.
- Fetch runs `git fetch --prune`, which deletes remote-tracking refs for branches the remote no longer has (matching
  GitHub Desktop).
- Your commit hooks run. A hook that blocks is your hook; `timeoutMs` is the only backstop.
- The trash keeps **that one diff**. Restoring replays it with `git apply`, which reproduces the exact bytes (verified
  with CRLF, no trailing newline, unicode, and trailing spaces). It replays only while the working tree is still what
  the discard left: if HEAD moved, or the files were touched since, the button greys out and says which — otherwise a
  stale change would land on top of newer work. **A restored change comes back ticked**: the host stages the paths the
  replay produced, which is the same "every changed file is ticked by default" rule and the same meaning a tick has
  everywhere else here (a real `git add`), so a terminal's `git status` agrees. **A successful restore removes the
  entry**: it is the reverse of the discard that made it, so once the change is back the archive has no use, and
  repla

The version number is the release button:

1. Change `version` in `package.json`.
2. Push to `main`.

`.github/workflows/publish.yml` runs `npm test`, then asks `npm view <name>@<version>` — **if that version is already
on the registry it skips quietly** (a green no-op that tells you to bump). Forgetting to bump therefore neither
republishes silently nor shows up as a red run.

Authentication is npm **Trusted Publishing (OIDC)**: there is no token secret anywhere, and `id-token: write` is the
whole credential.

<details>
<summary>One-time setup: bind a Trusted Publisher on npmjs.com</summary>

On the package page → Settings → Trusted Publisher:

| field | value |
|---|---|
| Publisher | GitHub Actions |
| Repository | `Ckarefulon/dsh-lite-git` |
| Workflow filename | `publish.yml` |
| Environment | (leave empty) |

**The first release must be a manual `npm publish`** — a Trusted Publisher can only be bound to a package name that
already exists on the registry.

The workflow deliberately does **not** use `actions/setup-node`'s `registry-url`: it writes
`_authToken=${NODE_AUTH_TOKEN}` into `~/.npmrc`, and that literal placeholder is then sent as a credential. The
registry comes from `publishConfig` instead.

It also upgrades npm to `^11.5.1` first: Trusted Publishing is a feature of the npm CLI, the npm 10 that ships with
Node 22 cannot speak OIDC, and on npm 10 the publish dies with `ENEEDAUTH` — which reads like a missing token but is
really an npm that is too old.

</details>
